C0474.title: Scalpers Emerge: Large Certificates of Deposit and Credit Card Points Become Resale Business
C0474.summary: An investigation by Beijing Business Daily reveals that financial scalpers have infiltrated the credit card points cash-out sector. Intermediaries use low-priced items on second-hand platforms to attract traffic, enticing cardholders to redeem points for virtual goods like shopping cards. The intermediaries then collect the cards and vouchers, convert them into cash settlements, and charge service
